local crosshair:Frame? = nil
local hitmarker:Frame? = nil
local activeTweens = {}
local pulseSerial = 0
local hapticSerial = 0
local shiftLockSignal:RBXScriptConnection? = nil
local fireBindings:{[Tool]:{connections:{RBXScriptConnection}, held:boolean, activeInput:InputObject?, onEnded:((any)->())?}} = {}

local function isTouchPrimary()
	return UserInputService.PreferredInput == Enum.PreferredInput.Touch
end

local function isRangedWeapon(tool:Tool?)
	return tool and (
		tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gun)
		or tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BarrelPistol4)
		or tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bow)
		or tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gatlin)
	) == true
end

local function getPlayerGui()
	return player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
end

local function getMobileFrame()
	local playerGui = getPlayerGui()
	local uiInterface = playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild("UIInterface")
	return uiInterface and uiInterface:FindFirstChild("UIInteractiveMobile", true)
end

local function getShiftLockButton()
	local mobileFrame = getMobileFrame()
	return mobileFrame and mobileFrame:FindFirstChild("ShiftLock")
end

local function getFireButton()
	local mobileFrame = getMobileFrame()
	local button = mobileFrame and mobileFrame:FindFirstChild("Fire")
	return button and button:IsA("GuiButton") and button or nil
end

local function isMobileShiftLockActive()
	local button = getShiftLockButton()
	return button ~= nil and button:GetAttribute("ShiftLockActive") == true
end

local function makeLine(parent:Instance, name:string, size:UDim2, position:UDim2, rotation:number?)
	local line = Instance.new("Frame")
	line.Name = name
	line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	line.Position = position
	line.Size = size
	line.Rotation = rotation or 0
	line.BorderSizePixel = 0
	line.BackgroundColor3 = BODY_COLOR
	line.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	line.ZIndex = 42
	line.Parent = parent

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Name = "Contrast"
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 24)
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.Transparency = 0.25
	stroke.Parent = line
	return line
end

local function ensureOverlay()
	if overlay and overlay.Parent and crosshair and hitmarker then
		return overlay, crosshair, hitmarker
	end

	local playerGui = getPlayerGui()
	if not playerGui then return nil end

	local existing = playerGui:FindFirstChild("MobileAimOverlay")
	if existing and existing:IsA("ScreenGui") then
		existing:Destroy()
	end

	overlay = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	overlay.Name = "MobileAimOverlay"
	overlay.ResetOnSpawn = false
	overlay.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	overlay.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.DeviceSafeInsets
	overlay.SafeAreaCompatibility = Enum.SafeAreaCompatibility.FullscreenExtension
	overlay.ClipToDeviceSafeArea = false
	overlay.DisplayOrder = 25
	overlay.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	overlay.Parent = playerGui

	crosshair = Instance.new("Frame")
	crosshair.Name = "Crosshair"
	crosshair.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	crosshair.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	crosshair.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
	crosshair.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	crosshair.Visible = false
	crosshair.ZIndex = 40
	crosshair.Parent = overlay

	makeLine(crosshair, "Top", UDim2.fromOffset(2, 7), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 2.5))
	makeLine(crosshair, "Bottom", UDim2.fromOffset(2, 7), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 21.5))
	makeLine(crosshair, "Left", UDim2.fromOffset(7, 2), UDim2.fromOffset(2.5, 12))
	makeLine(crosshair, "Right", UDim2.fromOffset(7, 2), UDim2.fromOffset(21.5, 12))
	makeLine(crosshair, "Dot", UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12))
	local crosshairScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	crosshairScale.Name = "ResponsiveScale"
	crosshairScale.Parent = crosshair

	hitmarker = Instance.new("Frame")
	hitmarker.Name = "Hitmarker"
	hitmarker.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	hitmarker.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	hitmarker.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
	hitmarker.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hitmarker.Visible = false
	hitmarker.ZIndex = 45
	hitmarker.Parent = overlay

	makeLine(hitmarker, "SlashDown", UDim2.fromOffset(2, 16), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), -45)
	makeLine(hitmarker, "SlashUp", UDim2.fromOffset(2, 16), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), 45)
	local markerScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	markerScale.Name = "PulseScale"
	markerScale.Parent = hitmarker

	return overlay, crosshair, hitmarker
end

local function setGraphicColor(root:GuiObject?, color:Color3)
	if not root then return end
	for _, descendant in root:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("Frame") then
			descendant.BackgroundColor3 = color
		end
	end
end

local function setGraphicTransparency(root:GuiObject?, transparency:number)
	if not root then return end
	for _, descendant in root:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("Frame") then
			descendant.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
		end
	end
end

local function cancelTweens()
	for _, tween in activeTweens do
		tween:Cancel()
	end
	table.clear(activeTweens)
end

local function refreshCrosshair()
	local visible = featureSwitch.Value
		and isTouchPrimary()
		and boundTool ~= nil
		and boundTool.Parent == player.Character
		and isMobileShiftLockActive()
	if visible then
		ensureOverlay()
	end
	if crosshair then
		crosshair.Visible = visible
		crosshair.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		local responsiveScale = crosshair:FindFirstChild("ResponsiveScale")
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if responsiveScale and responsiveScale:IsA("UIScale") and camera then
			local shortSide = math.min(camera.ViewportSize.X, camera.ViewportSize.Y)
			responsiveScale.Scale = math.clamp(shortSide * 0.06, 18, 26) / 24
		end
	end
	if not visible and hitmarker then
		hitmarker.Visible = false
	end
end

local function connectShiftLockSignal()
	if shiftLockSignal then
		shiftLockSignal:Disconnect()
		shiftLockSignal = nil
	end
	local button = getShiftLockButton()
	if button then
		shiftLockSignal = button:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ShiftLockActive"):Connect(refreshCrosshair)
	end
end

local function removeToken(token:number)
	if not tokenRecords[token] then return end
	tokenRecords[token] = nil
	for index, value in tokenOrder do
		if value == token then
			table.remove(tokenOrder, index)
			break
		end
	end
end

local function rememberToken(token:number, record)
	tokenRecords[token] = record
	table.insert(tokenOrder, token)
	while #tokenOrder > MAX_TOKENS do
		local oldest = table.remove(tokenOrder, 1)
		tokenRecords[oldest] = nil
	end
	task.delay(TOKEN_TTL, function()
		removeToken(token)
	end)
end

local function buildRay(screenPoint:Vector2?, centerLock:boolean)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return nil end

	if centerLock then
		local viewportPoint = camera.ViewportSize * 0.5
		local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(viewportPoint.X, viewportPoint.Y)
		local topLeftInset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
		return camera, ray, viewportPoint, viewportPoint - topLeftInset
	end

	local actualScreenPoint = screenPoint
	if typeof(actualScreenPoint) ~= "Vector2" then
		if isTouchPrimary() then
			return nil
		end
		actualScreenPoint = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	end
	-- TouchTapInWorld already reports device-safe viewport coordinates.
	-- ScreenPointToRay would apply the Core UI inset a second time on notched devices.
	local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(actualScreenPoint.X, actualScreenPoint.Y)
	return camera, ray, actualScreenPoint, actualScreenPoint
end

local function raycastAim(ray:Ray)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	if player.Character then
		params:AddToFilter(player.Character)
	end
	params:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
	local result = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * MAX_AIM_DISTANCE, params)
	return result and result.Position or (ray.Origin + ray.Direction * MAX_AIM_DISTANCE)
end

function RangedCombatClient.IsRangedWeapon(tool:Tool?)
	return isRangedWeapon(tool)
end

function RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled()
	-- The switch intentionally gates only the touch-primary experience.
	-- Desktop callers therefore continue through their established mouse paths.
	return featureSwitch.Value == true and isTouchPrimary()
end

function RangedCombatClient.IsMobile()
	return isTouchPrimary()
end

function RangedCombatClient.IsMobileShiftLockActive()
	return isMobileShiftLockActive()
end

function RangedCombatClient.SampleAim(options)
	options = type(options) == "table" and options or {}
	local touchMode = isTouchPrimary()
	local centerLock = touchMode and (
		isMobileShiftLockActive()
		or options.Trigger == "CenterButton"
	)
	local camera, ray, viewportPoint, screenPoint = buildRay(options.ScreenPoint, centerLock)
	if not camera or not ray then
		return nil
	end
	return {
		AimWorldPosition = raycastAim(ray),
		ScreenPoint = screenPoint,
		ViewportPoint = viewportPoint,
		IsCenterLock = centerLock,
	}
end

function RangedCombatClient.BeginShot(options)
	local aimContext = RangedCombatClient.SampleAim(options)
	if not aimContext then return nil end

	nextToken += 1
	if nextToken >= 2147483647 then nextToken = 1 end
	aimContext.ShotToken = nextToken
	rememberToken(aimContext.ShotToken, {
		ScreenPoint = aimContext.ScreenPoint,
		ViewportPoint = aimContext.ViewportPoint,
		IsCenterLock = aimContext.IsCenterLock,
		Tool = boundTool,
	})
	return aimContext
end

local function stopHaptics()
	hapticSerial += 1
	pcall(function()
		HapticService:SetMotor(Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1, Enum.VibrationMotor.Small, 0)
		HapticService:SetMotor(Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1, Enum.VibrationMotor.Large, 0)
	end)
end

local function playHaptic(isKill:boolean, isHeadshot:boolean)
	if not isTouchPrimary() or (not isKill and not isHeadshot) then return end
	local inputType = Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
	local motor = isKill and Enum.VibrationMotor.Large or Enum.VibrationMotor.Small
	local supported = false
	pcall(function()
		supported = HapticService:IsVibrationSupported(inputType)
			and HapticService:IsMotorSupported(inputType, motor)
	end)
	if not supported then return end
	hapticSerial += 1
	local serial = hapticSerial
	local magnitude = isKill and 0.35 or 0.2
	pcall(function()
		HapticService:SetMotor(inputType, Enum.VibrationMotor.Small, 0)
		HapticService:SetMotor(inputType, Enum.VibrationMotor.Large, 0)
		HapticService:SetMotor(inputType, motor, magnitude)
	end)
	task.delay(isKill and 0.04 or 0.025, function()
		if serial ~= hapticSerial then return end
		pcall(function() HapticService:SetMotor(inputType, motor, 0) end)
	end)
end

local function pulseHitmarker(record, payload)
	local _, _, marker = ensureOverlay()
	if not marker then return end

	pulseSerial += 1
	local serial = pulseSerial
	cancelTweens()
	setGraphicColor(crosshair, BODY_COLOR)
	setGraphicTransparency(marker, 0)

	local isKill = payload.IsKill == true
	local isHeadshot = payload.IsHeadshot == true
	local color = isKill and KILL_COLOR or (isHeadshot and CRITICAL_COLOR or BODY_COLOR)
	local startSize = isKill and 24 or (isHeadshot and 22 or 18)
	local peakSize = isKill and 31 or (isHeadshot and 27 or 21)
	local expandTime = isKill and 0.08 or 0.065
	local fadeTime = isKill and 0.18 or (isHeadshot and 0.13 or 0.1)

	local markerPoint = record.ViewportPoint
	marker.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(markerPoint.X, markerPoint.Y)
	marker.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
	marker.Visible = true
	setGraphicColor(marker, color)
	setGraphicTransparency(marker, 0)
	local markerScale = marker:FindFirstChild("PulseScale")
	if not markerScale or not markerScale:IsA("UIScale") then return end
	markerScale.Scale = startSize / 20

	if (isKill or isHeadshot) and crosshair and record.IsCenterLock then
		setGraphicColor(crosshair, CRITICAL_COLOR)
	end
	playHaptic(isKill, isHeadshot)

	local expand = TweenService:Create(markerScale, TweenInfo.new(expandTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Scale = peakSize / 20,
	})
	table.insert(activeTweens, expand)
	expand:Play()
	expand.Completed:Once(function()
		if serial ~= pulseSerial or not marker.Parent then return end
		local fade = TweenService:Create(markerScale, TweenInfo.new(fadeTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Scale = startSize / 20,
		})
		table.insert(activeTweens, fade)
		for _, descendant in marker:GetDescendants() do
			if descendant:IsA("Frame") then
				local lineFade = TweenService:Create(descendant, TweenInfo.new(fadeTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				})
				table.insert(activeTweens, lineFade)
				lineFade:Play()
			end
		end
		fade:Play()
		task.delay(fadeTime, function()
			if serial ~= pulseSerial or not marker.Parent then return end
			marker.Visible = false
			setGraphicColor(crosshair, BODY_COLOR)
		end)
	end)
end

function RangedCombatClient.PulseHit(payload)
	if not featureSwitch.Value or not isTouchPrimary() or type(payload) ~= "table" then return end
	local token = payload.ShotToken
	if type(token) ~= "number" then return end
	local record = tokenRecords[token]
	if not record then return end
	pulseHitmarker(record, payload)
	if payload.IsKill == true then
		removeToken(token)
	end
end

local function finishBinding(binding, context)
	if not binding.held then return end
	binding.held = false
	binding.activeInput = nil
	if binding.onEnded then
		binding.onEnded(context)
	end
end

function RangedCombatClient.UnbindFireActions(tool:Tool)
	local binding = fireBindings[tool]
	if not binding then return end
	finishBinding(binding, {Trigger = "Cancelled"})
	for _, connection in binding.connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	fireBindings[tool] = nil
end

function RangedCombatClient.BindFireActions(tool:Tool, onBegan:(any)->(), onEnded:((any)->())?)
	if not isRangedWeapon(tool) or type(onBegan) ~= "function" then return end
	RangedCombatClient.UnbindFireActions(tool)
	if not RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then return end

	local binding = {
		connections = {},
		held = false,
		activeInput = nil,
		onEnded = onEnded,
	}
	fireBindings[tool] = binding

	local function isUsable()
		return RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled()
			and tool.Parent == player.Character
			and fireBindings[tool] == binding
	end

	local function begin(context, continuous:boolean)
		if not isUsable() then return end
		if continuous then
			if binding.held then return end
			binding.held = true
		end
		onBegan(context)
	end

	local fireButton = getFireButton()
	if fireButton then
		table.insert(binding.connections, fireButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input:InputObject)
			if not fireButton.Visible then return end
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			if not isMobileShiftLockActive() or binding.held then return end
			binding.activeInput = input
			begin({
				Trigger = "CenterButton",
				ScreenPoint = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y),
			}, true)
		end))
		table.insert(binding.connections, fireButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(input:InputObject)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			if input ~= binding.activeInput then return end
			finishBinding(binding, {Trigger = "CenterButton"})
		end))
		table.insert(binding.connections, fireButton:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			if not fireButton.Visible then
				finishBinding(binding, {Trigger = "Cancelled"})
			end
		end))
	end

	table.insert(binding.connections, UserInputService.TouchTapInWorld:Connect(function(position:Vector2, processedByUI:boolean)
		if processedByUI or isMobileShiftLockActive() then return end
		begin({
			Trigger = "WorldTap",
			ScreenPoint = position,
		}, false)
		if onEnded then
			onEnded({Trigger = "WorldTap", ScreenPoint = position})
		end
	end))
end

function RangedCombatClient.BindWeaponCrosshair(tool:Tool)
	if not isRangedWeapon(tool) then return end
	boundTool = tool
	connectShiftLockSignal()
	refreshCrosshair()
end

function RangedCombatClient.UnbindWeaponCrosshair(tool:Tool?)
	if tool and boundTool and tool ~= boundTool then return end
	if tool then
		RangedCombatClient.UnbindFireActions(tool)
		local ownedTokens = {}
		for token, record in tokenRecords do
			if record.Tool == tool then
				table.insert(ownedTokens, token)
			end
		end
		for _, token in ownedTokens do
			removeToken(token)
		end
	end
	boundTool = nil
	if shiftLockSignal then
		shiftLockSignal:Disconnect()
		shiftLockSignal = nil
	end
	pulseSerial += 1
	cancelTweens()
	stopHaptics()
	if crosshair then
		crosshair.Visible = false
		setGraphicColor(crosshair, BODY_COLOR)
	end
	if hitmarker then hitmarker.Visible = false end
end

local function clearNewMode()
	local toolsToUnbind = {}
	for tool in fireBindings do
		table.insert(toolsToUnbind, tool)
	end
	for _, tool in toolsToUnbind do
		RangedCombatClient.UnbindFireActions(tool)
	end
	table.clear(tokenRecords)
	table.clear(tokenOrder)
	pulseSerial += 1
	cancelTweens()
	stopHaptics()
	if crosshair then
		crosshair.Visible = false
		setGraphicColor(crosshair, BODY_COLOR)
	end
	if hitmarker then hitmarker.Visible = false end
end

featureSwitch.Changed:Connect(function()
	if not featureSwitch.Value then clearNewMode() end
	refreshCrosshair()
end)
UserInputService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PreferredInput"):Connect(function()
	if not isTouchPrimary() then clearNewMode() end
	refreshCrosshair()
end)
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	clearNewMode()
	boundTool = nil
	if shiftLockSignal then
		shiftLockSignal:Disconnect()
		shiftLockSignal = nil
	end
	task.defer(function()
		connectShiftLockSignal()
		refreshCrosshair()
	end)
end)
feedbackEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(RangedCombatClient.PulseHit)

return RangedCombatClient

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CommonFunc = {}

math.random(tick())

function CommonFunc:ForDescendant(ins:Instance, func,inSelf:boolean)
	if not ins then
		return
	end

	if inSelf then
		func(ins)
	end

	for _, ins in ipairs(ins:GetDescendants()) do
		if func(ins) then
			break
		end
	end
end

function CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(ins:Instance,tag:string)
	local ret:Instance = ins
	if not ret then return end
	if ret:HasTag(tag) then return ret end
	return CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(ret.Parent,tag)
end

function CommonFunc:GetModelOrTool(ins:Instance)
	local model:Model = nil

	if ins then
		if ins:IsA("Model") then
			model = ins
		else
			model = ins:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
		end
	end

	return model
end

function CommonFunc:GetModel(ins:Instance)
	local model:Model = nil

	if ins then
		if ins.ClassName == "Model" then
			model = ins
		else
			model = ins:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		end
	end

	return model
end

function CommonFunc:GetCharacter(obj:Instance)
	local character:Model = nil

	if obj then
		if obj.ClassName == "Model" then
			character = obj
		else
			character = CommonFunc:GetCharacter(obj.Parent)
		end
	end

	return character
end

function CommonFunc:SetCharacterCollisionGroup(obj, collisionGroup)
	local character = CommonFunc:GetCharacter(obj)
	
	CommonFunc:ForDescendant(character, function(ins)
		if ins:IsA("BasePart") then
			ins.CollisionGroup = collisionGroup
		end
	end)
end

function CommonFunc:SetCanCollision(basePart:BasePart, enabled:boolean)	
	CommonFunc:ForDescendant(basePart, function(child:BasePart)
		if child:IsA("BasePart") then
			child.CanCollide = enabled
			child.CanQuery = enabled
			child.CanTouch = enabled
		end
	end,true)
end

function CommonFunc:SetCanCollide(basePart:BasePart, enabled:boolean)	
	CommonFunc:ForDescendant(basePart, function(child:BasePart)
		if child:IsA("BasePart") then
			child.CanCollide = enabled
		end
	end,true)
end

function CommonFunc:SetCollisionGroup(obj:BasePart, collisionGroup)	
	-- obj.CollisionGroup = collisionGroup
	CommonFunc:ForDescendant(obj, function(ins:BasePart)
		if ins:IsA("BasePart") then
			ins.CollisionGroup = collisionGroup
		end
	end,true)
end

function CommonFunc:SetPhysicalProperties(obj, physicalProperties:PhysicalProperties)
	local character = CommonFunc:GetCharacter(obj)

	CommonFunc:ForDescendant(character, function(ins)
		if ins:IsA("BasePart") then
			ins.CustomPhysicalProperties = physicalProperties
		end
	end)
end

function CommonFunc:CreateConnectionProxy(instance:Instance)
	local proxy = {}
	proxy.connections = {}
	
	function proxy:Add(connection:RBXScriptConnection)
		if not connection then
			return
		end
		table.insert(proxy.connections,connection)
		return connection
	end
	
	function proxy:Remove(connection:RBXScriptConnection,disconnect)
		if not connection then
			return
		end
		local index = table.find(proxy.connections,connection)
		if index then
			table.remove(proxy.connections,index)
		end
		if disconnect then
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
	end

	function proxy:DisconnectAll()
		for _, connection:RBXScriptConnection in ipairs(proxy.connections) do
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
		table.clear(proxy.connections)
	end
	
	if instance then
		proxy:Add(instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
			proxy:DisconnectAll()
		end))
		proxy:Add(instance.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(child, parent)
			if not instance:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				proxy:DisconnectAll()
			end
		end))
	end

	return proxy
end

function CommonFunc:Sum(array)
	if not array then
		return 0
	end
	
	local ret = 0
	for _,val in array do
		ret += val
	end
	return ret
end

function CommonFunc:RandomFolat(min,max)
	return min + math.random() * (max - min)
end

function CommonFunc:RandomSign()
	if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
		return 1
	end
	return -1
end

function CommonFunc:RandomVector3(range:number)
	return Vector3.new(CommonFunc:RandomSign() * math.random() * range,CommonFunc:RandomSign() * math.random() * range,CommonFunc:RandomSign() * math.random() * range)
end

-- 通用权重随机函数
function CommonFunc:WeightedRandom(choices)
	local totalWeight = 0

	-- 计算总权重
	for _, choice in ipairs(choices) do
		totalWeight = totalWeight + choice.weight
	end

	-- 生成一个随机数，范围在 1 到 totalWeight 之间
	local randomWeight = math.random() * totalWeight
	local cumulativeWeight = 0

	-- 遍历选择项，找到对应的随机选择
	for _, choice in ipairs(choices) do
		cumulativeWeight = cumulativeWeight + choice.weight
		if randomWeight <= cumulativeWeight then
			return choice.item
		end
	end
end

-- 通用权重随机函数V1
function CommonFunc:WeightedRandomV1(choices,vname:string)
	local totalWeight = 0
	if not vname then vname = "weight" end

	-- 计算总权重
	for _, choice in ipairs(choices) do
		totalWeight = totalWeight + choice[vname]
	end

	-- 生成一个随机数，范围在 1 到 totalWeight 之间
	local randomWeight = math.random() * totalWeight
	local cumulativeWeight = 0

	-- 遍历选择项，找到对应的随机选择
	for _, choice in ipairs(choices) do
		cumulativeWeight = cumulativeWeight + choice[vname]
		if randomWeight <= cumulativeWeight then
			return choice
		end
	end
end

function CommonFunc:StringToColor3(colorString)
	colorString = string.gsub(colorString," ","")
	-- 按逗号拆分字符串
	local r, g, b = colorString:match("(%d+),(%d+),(%d+)")

	-- 将字符串转换为数字
	r = tonumber(r)
	g = tonumber(g)
	b = tonumber(b)

	-- 检查是否为有效数字
	if not (r and g and b) then
		warn("无效的颜色字符串:", colorString)
		return nil
	end

	-- 将 0-255 的范围归一化为 0-1
	local color = Color3.new(r / 255, g / 255, b / 255)
	return color
end

function CommonFunc:IsNewDay(time:number)
	if not time then return true end

    local currentDate = os.date("!*t",workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) -- 获取当前日期
	local checkDate = os.date("!*t",time)

	-- 比较日期
    if currentDate.year ~= checkDate.year or
       currentDate.month ~= checkDate.month or
       currentDate.day ~= checkDate.day then
        checkDate = currentDate -- 更新记录
        return true
    end

    return false
end
function CommonFunc:GetUTCTomorrow(time:number)

		time = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	end

    local currentTimeTable = os.date("!*t",time) -- 获取当前日期
    -- 明天0点的时间表
    currentTimeTable.hour = 24  -- 将小时设置为24（这将自动增加到下一天）
    currentTimeTable.min = 0
    currentTimeTable.sec = 0

	-- 转换回时间戳

    return tomorrowMidnightTimestamp

function CommonFunc:UIRepeatedScaling(gui:GuiObject,play:boolean,repeatCount:number)
	local tween:Tween = gui:FindFirstChild("RepeatedScaling")
	if not tween then
		local uiscale:UIScale = gui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIScale")
		if not uiscale then
			uiscale = Instance.new("UIScale")
			uiscale.Parent = gui
		end

		if not repeatCount then
			repeatCount = -1
		end
		tween = TweenService:Create(uiscale,TweenInfo.new(0.5,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,repeatCount,true),{
			Scale = 1.5
		})
		tween.Name = "RepeatedScaling"
		tween.Parent = gui
		
		local boolValue = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		boolValue.Name = "Playing"
		boolValue.Parent = tween
		boolValue.Value = false

		if repeatCount ~= -1 then
			tween.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState)
				boolValue.Value = false
			end)
		end
	end
	-- local uiscale:UIScale = gui:FindFirstChild("UIScale_RepeatedScaling")
	local boolValue:BoolValue = tween:FindFirstChild("Playing")
	local uiscale:UIScale = gui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIScale")
	if play then
		if not boolValue.Value then
			uiscale.Scale = 1
			boolValue.Value = true
			tween:Play()
		end
	else
		if boolValue.Value then
			boolValue.Value = false
			tween:Cancel()
		end
		uiscale.Scale = 1
	end
end

function CommonFunc:PlayShockView(offset:number)
	local localPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
	local character = localPlayer.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	if not offset then
		offset = 1
	end
	local humanoid:Humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	local cameraSession = humanoid:GetAttribute("RangedCameraSession")
	local initialBase = humanoid:GetAttribute("RangedCameraOffset")
	if typeof(initialBase) ~= "Vector3" then
		initialBase = humanoid.CameraOffset
	end
	local function isCurrentSession()
		return localPlayer.Character == character
			and humanoid.Parent ~= nil
			and humanoid:GetAttribute("RangedCameraSession") == cameraSession
	end
	local function getBaseOffset()
		local currentBase = humanoid:GetAttribute("RangedCameraOffset")
		return typeof(currentBase) == "Vector3" and currentBase or initialBase
	end
	local times = 6
	local rate = 0.2
	local play
	play = function()
		if not isCurrentSession() then
			return
		end
		if times <= 0 then
			humanoid.CameraOffset = getBaseOffset()
			return
		end
		times -= 1
		local jitter = Vector3.new(math.random(-offset,offset) * rate,math.random(-offset,offset) * rate,math.random(-offset,offset) * rate)
		local tween = TweenService:Create(humanoid,TweenInfo.new(0.05),{
			CameraOffset = getBaseOffset() + jitter
		})
		tween.Completed:Once(play)
		tween:Play()
	end
	play()
end

function CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal(tag:string,onTagAdded:(ins:Instance,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})->(),onTagRemoved:(ins:Instance)->())

		for _,ins:Instance in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(tag)) do
			connectionsMap[ins] = {}
			onTagAdded(ins,connectionsMap[ins])
		end
		CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(tag):Connect(function(ins:Instance)
			connectionsMap[ins] = {}
			onTagAdded(ins,connectionsMap[ins])
		end)

		CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(tag):Connect(function(ins:Instance)
			local connections = connectionsMap[ins]
			connectionsMap[ins] = nil
			for _,c in ipairs(connections) do
				c:Disconnect()
			end
		
			if onTagRemoved then
				onTagRemoved(ins)
			end
		end)
	end
end

function CommonFunc:GetPreciseDecimal(nNum, n)
	if type(nNum) ~= "number" then
		return nNum;
	end
	n = n or 0;
	n = math.floor(n)
	if n < 0 then
		n = 0;
	end
	local nDecimal = 10 ^ n
	local nTemp = math.floor(nNum * nDecimal);
	local nRet = nTemp / nDecimal;
	return nRet;
end

--数字转数字缩写文本
-- nNum 源数字
-- n 小数位数 默认1
function CommonFunc:NumToNumStr(nNum,n)
	if type(nNum) ~= "number" then
		return nNum;
	end
	n = n or 1
	n = math.floor(n)
	if n < 0 then
		n = 0
	end
	local str =''
	
	if nNum>=10000000000000000 then
		str=CommonFunc:GetPreciseDecimal(nNum/10000000000000000,n)..'Qa'
	elseif nNum>=1000000000000 then
		str=CommonFunc:GetPreciseDecimal(nNum/1000000000000,n)..'T'
	elseif nNum>=1000000000 then
		str=CommonFunc:GetPreciseDecimal(nNum/1000000000,n)..'B'
	elseif nNum>=1000000 then
		str=CommonFunc:GetPreciseDecimal(nNum/1000000,n)..'M'
	elseif nNum>=1000 then
		str=CommonFunc:GetPreciseDecimal(nNum/1000,n)..'K'
	else
		str=CommonFunc:GetPreciseDecimal(nNum,n)
	end
	return str
end

-- 是否有阻挡
function CommonFunc:IsModelObstruction(origin:Model,target:Model,distance:number,ignores:{{Instance}})
	local originRootPart:Part = origin:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local targetRootPart:Part = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
	raycastParams:AddToFilter({origin,target})
	if ignores then
		for _,ignore in ipairs(ignores) do
			raycastParams:AddToFilter(ignore)
		end
	end
	raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	local offset = (targetRootPart.Position - originRootPart.Position)
	local hitResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(originRootPart.Position,offset.Unit*distance,raycastParams)
	return hitResult ~= nil
end

-- 是否有阻挡
function CommonFunc:IsModelObstructionByCollsionGroup(origin:Model,target:Model,collisionGroup:string)
	local originRootPart:Part = origin:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local targetRootPart:Part = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
	raycastParams:AddToFilter({origin,target})
	raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	raycastParams.CollisionGroup = collisionGroup

	local offset = (targetRootPart.Position - originRootPart.Position)
	local hitResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(originRootPart.Position,offset.Unit*offset.Magnitude,raycastParams)
	return hitResult ~= nil
end

-- 角色等级数值增长公式
function Formula.segmentGrowth(initVal, targetVal, initLv, targetLv,lv)
	-- 定义阶段划分点（实际关卡数）
	local stage1End = 3  -- 阶段1结束于第3级
	local stage2End = 7  -- 阶段2结束于第7级

	-- print("\n各级数值结果：")
	local value

	if lv <= stage1End then
		-- 阶段1：线性增长（占总增长的30%）
		local progress = (lv - initLv) / (stage1End - initLv)
		value = initVal + (targetVal - initVal) * 0.3 * progress

	elseif lv <= stage2End then
		-- 阶段2：指数增长（占总增长的40%）
		local stage1Value = initVal + (targetVal - initVal) * 0.3  -- 阶段1结束值
		local stage2Progress = (lv - stage1End) / (stage2End - stage1End)
		local exponent = math.pow(2, stage2Progress)  -- 指数从1增长到2
		value = stage1Value + (targetVal - initVal) * 0.4 * (exponent - 1)

	else
		-- 阶段3：线性调整（占总增长的30%）
		local stage2Value = initVal + (targetVal - initVal) * 0.7  -- 阶段2结束值
		local stage3Progress = (lv - stage2End) / (targetLv - stage2End)
		value = stage2Value + (targetVal - initVal) * 0.3 * stage3Progress
	end

	-- print(string.format("    %d级: %.2f", lv, value))
    return value
end

-- 怪物三阶段多项式成长函数
function Formula.multiStageGrowth(level, base, stage1, stage2, stage3)
    local phase1 = 20
    local phase2 = 40
    if level <= phase1 then  -- 阶段1：平滑增长
        return base * (1 + stage1.linear * level + stage1.quad * level^2)
    elseif level <= phase2 then  -- 阶段2：中等增速
        local baseValue = Formula.multiStageGrowth(phase1, base, stage1, stage2, stage3)
        local deltaLevel = level - phase1
        return baseValue * (1 + stage2.linear * deltaLevel + stage2.quad * deltaLevel^2)
    else  -- 阶段3：快速增长（加入指数项）
        local baseValue = Formula.multiStageGrowth(phase2, base, stage1, stage2, stage3)
        local deltaLevel = level - phase2
        return baseValue * (1 + stage3.linear * deltaLevel + stage3.quad * deltaLevel^2 + stage3.exp * 2^(deltaLevel/3))
    end
end

-- 计算攻击力
function Formula.calculateAttack(level, baseAttack, multiplier)
    multiplier = multiplier or 1

    local attack = Formula.multiStageGrowth(level, baseAttack,
        {linear=0.1, quad=0.01},    -- 阶段1
        {linear=0.15, quad=0.02},   -- 阶段2
        {linear=0.2, quad=0.03, exp=0.05}  -- 阶段3
    )

    -- 难度乘数
    attack = attack * multiplier

    -- 随机波动 (±10%)
    attack = attack * (0.9 + math.random() * 0.2)

    return math.floor(attack)
end

-- 计算血量
function Formula.calculateHP(level, baseHP, multiplier)
    multiplier = multiplier or 1

    local hp = Formula.multiStageGrowth(level, baseHP,
        {linear=0.15, quad=0.015},  -- 阶段1（血量增长略快于攻击）
        {linear=0.25, quad=0.03},   -- 阶段2
        {linear=0.35, quad=0.05, exp=0.1}  -- 阶段3（血量大幅增长）
    )

    -- 难度乘数
    hp = hp * multiplier

    -- 随机波动 (±15%)
    -- hp = hp * (0.85 + math.random() * 0.3)

    return math.floor(hp)
end

return Formula"},{"id":474,"text":"local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
-- main

local Effect = {}
local Hook = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("eff"):WaitForChild("objects"):WaitForChild("grapple_hook")
local EffectPart = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("eff"):WaitForChild("objects"):WaitForChild("grapple_hook_effect")
local RootEmitter = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("eff"):WaitForChild("objects"):WaitForChild("grapple_root_emitter")
local CastSound = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("eff"):WaitForChild("objects"):WaitForChild("grapple_cast_sound")
function Effect.play(character, position, castTime, travelTime)
	coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(function()
		if not character then
			return
		end
		
		local hand = character:FindFirstChild("RightHand")

		if not hand then
			return
		end

		local grip = hand:FindFirstChild("RightGripAttachment")

		if not grip then
			return
		end

		wait(castTime / 2)

		local castSound = character.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("grapple_cast_sound")

		if not castSound then
			castSound = CastSound:Clone()
			castSound.Parent = character.PrimaryPart
		end

		castSound:Play()

		local rootEmitter = character.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("grapple_root_emitter")
		if not rootEmitter then
			rootEmitter = RootEmitter:Clone()
			rootEmitter.Parent = character.PrimaryPart
		end

		rootEmitter.Enabled = true

		local hook = Hook:Clone()
		hook.Beam.Attachment0 = grip
		hook.CFrame = hand.CFrame
		hook.Parent = character

		local castInfo = TweenInfo.new(castTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		local castTween = TweenService:Create(hook, castInfo, {CFrame = CFrame.new(position)})

		castTween:Play()
		castTween.Completed:Wait()

		local effectPart = EffectPart:Clone()
		effectPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
		effectPart.Parent = character

		effectPart.DustEmitter:Emit(2)
		effectPart.SparkEmitter:Emit(20)

		Debris:AddItem(effectPart, 0.5)

		wait(travelTime - castTime)

		rootEmitter.Enabled = false
		hook:Destroy()
	end))
end


return Effect"},{"id":479,"text":"local PickupClass = {
